title: Alex’s Cardio Program
author: Alex
desc: To enhance cardiovascular health, improve endurance, and achieve a lower resting heart rate by following a structured, progressive 12-week cardio plan. This program is designed to increase aerobic capacity, improve heart efficiency, and support long-term cardiovascular resilience, ultimately promoting better overall health and fitness.
